title: Jinek and colleagues' 2012 CRISPR paper
summary: The Science paper describes a programmable dual-RNA-guided DNA endonuclease from bacterial immunity.
body: Martin Jinek, Krzysztof Chylinski, Ines Fonfara, Michael Hauer, Jennifer A. Doudna, Emmanuelle Charpentier, and colleagues, "A Programmable Dual-RNA–Guided DNA Endonuclease in Adaptive Bacterial Immunity" (Science, 2012), is a primary paper on using the bacterial CRISPR system as a programmable DNA cut. The paper is about a molecular tool. It is not a report that a disease has been cured. Clinical claims need their own trials.
